profile.name: Tecan Freedom EVO 自动化液体处理工作站
profile.name_en: Tecan Freedom EVO automated liquid handling workstation
profile.description: 一款用于实验室自动移液与板件搬运的台式自动化工作站，通常配备多通道 LiHa 液体处理臂，可完成吸液、分液、液面探测、一次性吸头装卸及多轴定位，并可结合 96 通道或板搬运模块执行样品制备、微孔板加样和高通量实验流程。
profile.description_en: A benchtop automated liquid handling workstation for laboratory pipetting and plate movement. It typically includes a multichannel LiHa liquid handling arm for aspirating, dispensing, liquid level detection, disposable tip handling, and multi-axis positioning, and may work with 96-channel or plate-handling modules for sample preparation, microplate filling, and high-throughput workflows.

registry.name: Tecan LiHa Liquid Handling Arm
registry.description: Tecan LiHa Liquid Handling Arm是由Tecan Group生产的移液工作站，主要功能包括停止、分液、初始化、启动、吸液、日志记录。支持Signal, Slot, can pick up tip等操作。
